label: Listening 1 — How many?
lines: Listening one. How many? Circle the right answer.
I've got four pencils in my pencil case.
There are twelve boys in my class.
My mum has got three cats and two dogs!
We've got six new computers in our classroom.
In my bag I've got two dictionaries and a notebook.

label: Listening 2 — Tidy up!
lines: Listening two. Tidy up! True or false?
Ben, are these your socks on the floor?
No, it isn't. That's Kate's book.
What about those shoes by the door?
They're my toys. I've got five new toy cars!

label: Listening 3 — At the toy shop
lines: Listening three. At the toy shop. Listen and complete.
Yes, please. How much are these teddy bears?
The red balls are three pounds.
OK. Two teddy bears and three balls, please.
Here you are. That's twenty-seven pounds, please.
Twenty-seven pounds. Here you are. Thank you!
